name: Интернет-магазин
description: Каталог, покупки, оплата и доставка. 12 запросов на 2 млн строк: B-tree и компактный BRIN для заказов за сутки при бюджете 8 MiB.
schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE public.customers (
  id integer PRIMARY KEY,
  region integer NOT NULL,
  segment integer NOT NULL,
  name text NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.categories (
  id integer PRIMARY KEY,
  name text NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.products (
  id integer PRIMARY KEY,
  category_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES public.categories(id),
  price integer NOT NULL,
  stock integer NOT NULL,
  name text NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.orders (
  id bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES public.customers(id),
  status integer NOT NULL,
  total integer NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.order_items (
  id bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orders(id),
  product_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES public.products(id),
  quantity integer NOT NULL,
  unit_price integer NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.payments (
  id bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orders(id),
  payer_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES public.customers(id),
  status integer NOT NULL,
  method integer NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.shipments (
  id bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orders(id),
  recipient_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES public.customers(id),
  status integer NOT NULL,
  region integer NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp NOT NULL
);
seed_sql:
INSERT INTO public.customers
SELECT i, (i % 20)::integer, ((i / 20) % 4)::integer, 'customer-' || i
FROM generate_series(1, 20000) AS g(i);
INSERT INTO public.categories
SELECT i, 'category-' || i FROM generate_series(1, 100) AS g(i);
INSERT INTO public.products
SELECT i, (i % 100 + 1)::integer, ((i * 37) % 10000 + 100)::integer,
       ((i / 100) % 50)::integer, 'product-' || i
FROM generate_series(1, 20000) AS g(i);
INSERT INTO public.orders
SELECT i, ((i * 73) % 20000 + 1)::integer, ((i / 20000) % 5)::integer,
       ((i * 37) % 10000 + 500)::integer,
       timestamp '2026-01-01' + i * interval '30 seconds'
FROM generate_series(1, 300000) AS g(i);
INSERT INTO public.order_items
SELECT i, ((i - 1) / 4 + 1)::bigint, ((i * 97 + i / 20000) % 20000 + 1)::integer,
       (i % 3 + 1)::integer, ((i * 37) % 10000 + 100)::integer
FROM generate_series(1, 1200000) AS g(i);
INSERT INTO public.payments
SELECT id, id, customer_id, ((id / 1000 + id / 20000) % 4)::integer, ((id / 7) % 3)::integer,
       created_at + interval '5 minutes'
FROM public.orders;
INSERT INTO public.shipments
SELECT id, id, customer_id, ((id / 1000 + id / 20000) % 4)::integer, ((id * 73 + id / 20000) % 20)::integer,
       created_at + interval '1 day'
FROM public.orders WHERE id <= 210000;

queries.sql: SELECT o.id, o.total, c.name FROM public.orders o INNER JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.id = 42 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id, customer_id, total FROM public.orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-04-10'::timestamp AND created_at < '2026-04-11'::timestamp
SELECT o.id, o.total, c.name FROM public.orders o INNER JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.region = 7 AND c.segment = 1 AND o.total >= 5000 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, c.name FROM public.products p INNER JOIN public.categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.id = 12 AND p.stock > 0 AND p.price BETWEEN 500 AND 5000 ORDER BY p.price ASC LIMIT 40
SELECT id, name, stock FROM public.products WHERE category_id IN (5, 12, 28) AND stock BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id, p.name, i.quantity, i.unit_price FROM public.orders o INNER JOIN public.order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN public.products p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = 120042 ORDER BY i.id ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id, o.created_at, i.quantity FROM public.products p INNER JOIN public.order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE p.id = 137 AND o.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.id, o.id, o.total FROM public.payments p INNER JOIN public.orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.status = 0 AND p.method = 1 AND o.created_at >= '2026-03-01'::timestamp ORDER BY p.created_at ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT p.id, o.total, c.name FROM public.customers c INNER JOIN public.payments p ON p.payer_id = c.id INNER JOIN public.orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE c.id = 42 AND p.status = 2 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT s.id, o.id, o.total FROM public.shipments s INNER JOIN public.orders o ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE s.region = 7 AND s.status = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY s.created_at ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT s.id, s.status, o.total, c.name FROM public.customers c INNER JOIN public.shipments s ON s.recipient_id = c.id INNER JOIN public.orders o ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE c.id = 42 AND s.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT s.id, p.id, o.total FROM public.shipments s INNER JOIN public.orders o ON s.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN public.payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE s.status = 3 AND p.status IN (0, 3) AND s.created_at < '2026-03-01'::timestamp ORDER BY s.created_at ASC LIMIT 100
